notes.title: Gameplay comfort update available!
notes.content:
Here’s what’s included in this patch:

Major addition:

Added a button to speed up battles to X1, X2, or X4! If you're tired of waiting for animations and feel under-stimulated, you can now speed up your games for more battles per session!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45302942/5bd19326376a3ab96d2e60660c08542dfe0a63a1.png[/img]

Loading optimizations:

No more loading between menus! Loading will now only occur during adventures and not when navigating between menus. (It's less frustrating to modify your deck or shop now!)

Minor addition:

Added an animation for the merchant to bring more life.
Increased tutorial visibility (it’s now impossible to miss in the main menu).

notes.title: Tutorial Available!
notes.content: Dear users! I’ve received some feedback asking for a clear explanation of the combat system. So, I decided to add a detailed tutorial that covers all the questions! Don’t hesitate to check it out—it takes about 3 minutes to fully understand the rules of duels.

notes.title: Compatibility with configurations not supporting Vulkan is now available!
notes.content:
Dear users, I have added an executable that allows the game to run on configurations that do not support Vulkan. (If your configuration supports it, please use the regular executable.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45302942/4d0bcaf4d8edf91b1a00e78f4f1ac2a17c0681b6.png[/img]

notes.title: Official Release!
notes.content: Cardio is finally here! After months of passionate development, the game is officially launched. To celebrate this milestone, I'm excited to offer you a special launch discount. Dive into the captivating world of Cardio now and enjoy hours of strategy and adventure. Don’t miss this chance to start your journey at a reduced price!

notes.title: Official Launch Announcement 🎉
notes.content:
💖 Cardio – the brand-new collectible card game with a roguelike twist – will officially launch on December 16th! Dive into a strategic universe where every card matters and your decisions shape your adventure.

💡 Get ready for an exciting experience blending tactics, creativity, and adrenaline.

📅 Join us on December 16th to see if you have what it takes to become the master of cards in Cardio! 💥
